questions.question: Which Nordic country is famous for ice and volcanoes?
questions.funFact: Iceland has no mosquitoes! It's one of the few places on Earth without them.
questions.didYouKnow: Iceland is one of the most volcanically active countries, with about 130 volcanoes.

questions.question: Which Nordic country is the home of Lego?
questions.funFact: Denmark is home to LEGO! The famous toy company was founded here in 1932.
questions.didYouKnow: Denmark has over 400 islands, but only 70 are inhabited.

questions.question: Which Nordic country is the home of Santa Claus?
questions.funFact: Finland has the most saunas per capita - about 1 sauna for every 2 people!
questions.didYouKnow: Finland is called the 'Land of a Thousand Lakes', but actually has about 188000 lakes.

questions.question: Which Nordic country made the world’s first ice hotel?
questions.funFact: Sweden has a hotel made entirely of ice that is rebuilt every winter.
questions.didYouKnow: Sweden is the 3rd largest country in the European Union by area but has a relatively small population.

questions.question: Which Nordic country is famous for fjords?
questions.funFact: Norway has the world's longest road tunnel - the Lærdal Tunnel at about 24.5 km (15.2 miles).
questions.didYouKnow: Norway is famous for its fjords - deep glacier-carved valleys filled with seawater.
